_notes.method: Comments drafted line by line from Oracle's own Exhibit 99.1 press releases (narrative and executive quotes, condensed statement of operations with printed YoY % in USD and constant currency, non-GAAP reconciliation and its footnotes on stock-based compensation by line, amortization schedule and tax rates, balance sheet, cash flow statement, trailing FCF table, Revenues by Offerings) plus the earnings-call excerpts already extracted in transcripts.json (calls.FY2025Q1 through FY2025Q4). YoY percentages are the ones Oracle printed; no percentage was computed here. Where a result is compared with guidance, the range comes from the prior quarter's call as recorded in transcripts.json. Quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 are the derived discrete figures in quarters.json (cumulative minus prior cumulative) and are labeled 'derived'; cumulative and trailing-twelve-month figures are as printed. Comments are capped at 28 words, exec-summary bullets at 22, and management quotes at 12 words. Spanish is written as natural Mexican business Spanish (mdd = millones de dólares; 'mil millones de dólares' for billions; AF = año fiscal; UPA = utilidad por acción; pb = puntos base).
_notes.caveats: (1) Oracle's FY2025 releases give no line-level explanation for hardware, services, sales and marketing, R&D, G&A, tax, interest or non-operating items; those comments state the printed change, add only related facts printed in the release (stock-based compensation by line, debt issued and repaid, effective tax rates) and say no driver was given. (2) Spanish renderings of management quotes are paraphrases, not verbatim; only the English carries verbatim quotes. (3) FY2025 revenue lines use the legacy captions 'Cloud services and license support' (key cloud) and 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (key software); Oracle recast them from Q1 FY2026, so the cloud/software split is not comparable with FY2026 rows (see quarters.json revenue_recast_fy2026_basis). (4) 'Gross margin' remarks are management's spoken comments; the release prints no gross margin. (5) The FY2025Q3 non-operating comment relies on a forward-looking flag made on the Q2 call, and the FY2025Q4 one on the Q3 call's '$0.03 plus' remark taken from the transcripts.json _note rather than a quoted excerpt. (6) Guidance bullets are drawn from the calls because the FY2025 releases contain no quantified guidance table. (7) Page references in src are to the release's printed page numbers and to transcript PDF pages as recorded in transcripts.json.

en: Margin compression: cloud/support cost +33% vs revenue +14%; non-GAAP operating margin down 244 bp as capacity comes online.
FY26 capex above $25B with FCF already negative; interest expense +11%, leases and payables rising; funding path is the key risk.
Delivery against a very high bar: cloud growth over 40%, OCI over 70%, RPO more than doubling; Stargate still not in RPO.
es: Compresión de margen: costo de nube/soporte +33% vs ingresos +14%; margen operativo no-GAAP -244 pb mientras entra capacidad.
Capex AF26 arriba de 25 mil millones con flujo libre negativo; intereses +11%, arrendamientos al alza; el fondeo es el riesgo clave.
Cumplir una vara muy alta: nube más de 40%, OCI más de 70%, RPO más que duplicadas; Stargate aún fuera.
